Data Analyst & Statistical Research Expert

I'm Maher Ali, an M.Phil. Statistician and Data Analyst with 5+ years of experience in statistical analysis, research analytics, and data-driven problem solving. As a published researcher, I bring academic expertise and practical analytical skills to transform complex data into accurate, meaningful, and publication-ready insights.

With 50+ international clients served, I help researchers, academics, students, and businesses make confident decisions through rigorous analysis, compelling visualizations, and clear interpretation.

My expertise spans Statistical Analysis, Research Data Analysis, Data Cleaning, EDA, Regression, Hypothesis Testing, Data Visualization, Excel, SPSS, Stata, Power BI, SQL, and Python.

From raw data to meaningful insight, I turn numbers into results that make an impact.

Work: Upwork & Fiverr - Business Data Analyst - Data collection, cleaning, regression, hypothesis testing, dashboards, client communication, managing end-to-end freelance projects, 50+ international clients served.
